rules.title: Massachusetts rent control ballot question (2026 initiative petition)
rules.requirement: The proposed ballot initiative would have limited annual rent increases for residences, with exemptions for several unit types including those operated solely for religious purposes. The Supreme Judicial Court ruled it cannot go on the November 2026 ballot because the religious exemption makes it a matter relating to religion.
rules.citation: Massachusetts Supreme Judicial Court ruling, June 23, 2026 (ballot question on rent control)
rules.status_basis: Supreme Judicial Court ruled the petition cannot go forward in November 2026; proponents hinted at a 2028 attempt.

coverage.summary: Would apply to residences generally, limiting annual rent increases.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Exempts several types of units, including ones operated solely for religious purposes.

rules.quoted_span: The proposal limits annual rent increases for residences, but it carved out exemptions for several types of units, including ones “operated solely for … religious … purposes."
